text:
maria: kicking off canary to eu-west (canary slot 3) for release tag rc/2026-03-19-1
deploy-bot: [deploy-start] env=prod-dedicated target=eu-west ratio=5% commit=5a9d2f tag=release/v2.3.1
thomas: noted, change window ends 22:00 UTC
jen: will watch latency & error-rate
ops-bot: metric alert subscription added: latency_p50, error_rate_5m
deploy-bot: [canary-finished] env=prod-dedicated target=eu-west status=partial-pass metrics: p50↑12% vs baseline, errors +0.3% (threshold 0.5)
maria: p50 spike looks correlated with long prompts — investigating
thomas: also seeing 502 spikes on two hosts, rolling logs:
```sh
kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod | grep "502"
```
jen: I want to pause promotion until we confirm
maria: agree. holding promotion. pin traffic to previous model variant for requests with latency >60ms
deploy-bot: Promotion paused by user=maria at 1765432245
thomas: decision: rollback canary to release/v2.3.0 on eu-west and open hotfix branch. tagging: release/v2.3.1-hotfix
deploy-bot: [rollback-start] env=prod-dedicated target=eu-west from=release/v2.3.1 to=release/v2.3.0
ops-bot: Scheduled smoke tests: smoke-suite/runtime-basic at 1765432300
deploy-bot: [rollback-finish] env=prod-dedicated target=eu-west status=success
jen: smoke tests passed, no 502s now. good.
maria: will create follow-up PR for quantization tweak, assigning @thomas and @jen
thomas: can we re-run canary tomorrow in the morning change window? prefer 06:00 UTC
maria: yes, scheduled rerun for 1765518500 (06:00 UTC) and will include pinned model config and stricter latency gates
deploy-bot: Note: promotion remained paused. No full rollout executed.
jen: filing release note: 'Canary paused/rolled back due to latency spike in eu-west; hotfix branch created and re-canary scheduled'
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
